selection_rule.teaser: Non-background candidates, confidence >= 0.9, native area 16..192; PC60 maximum C, COCO Object minimum C; ties lowest image index then receipt candidate index. No GT used.
selection_rule.segmentation: For each image choose its largest non-background GT class with >=128 valid pixels (tie lowest category ID); compute that single named-class IoU for both saved arms. Maximum TRACE-minus-Confidence in CD, Object, PC60; minimum in VOC21. Ties lowest image index. Require three strictly positive deltas and one strictly negative delta.
selection_rule.warning: Post-seal offline GT-selected extrema; not representative, not an aggregate performance estimate, not used to select the method or report overall metrics.

service_note: Suite seal flag is false by construction; retained service verified independently read-only. No seal changed.
mask_note: Actual new receipts are native boolean 16x16 packed little-endian, not 14x14; no resampling before decode.

normalization.formula: z=(x-mu)/sigma; xhat=z*sigma+mu; m=spatial_mean(xhat) per channel; b=clip(cycle_gbr(0.35*(xhat-m)+m),0,255); zC=z*M+((b-mu)/sigma)*(1-M)
normalization.mask_upsampling: torch interpolate nearest from recorded native shape to 224x224
normalization.display: Probe embedded as floating RGB /255; companion PNG rounded for inspection; float32 NPY preserves reconstruction values.

scope: C measured in sealed initial frozen readout at original query and original tokens, never remeasured. Confidence is a matched allocation control, not MLMP. Initial full-map prediction unavailable and never fabricated.
gt_conventions: 224x224 nearest; ignore 255; reduce-zero only where frozen protocol says so; category predictions already use per-category max over query probabilities before argmax.
bounds_note: One boundary episode may include later images in its JSON; only records with global index <400 enter selection. No per_image_json, full count arrays, model checkpoints or GPU calls loaded.
